tasks.summary_pl: Udziały 12:8:3:2. Jaka część kapitału ma najw. inwestor?
tasks.summary_en: Shares 12:8:3:2. Largest investor's part of capital?
tasks.statement_en: Four friends registered a company. The size of the shares of the individual partners in the company's share capital is expressed by the ratio 12:8:3:2. What part of the share capital does the largest investor's share constitute? A. 12% B. 32% C. 48% D. 52%
On the line with equation $y=ax+b$ lie the points $K=(1,0)$ and $L=(0,1)$. It follows that: A. $a=-1$ and $b=1$ B. $a=1$ and $b=-1$ C. $a=-1$ and $b=-1$ D. $a=1$ and $b=1$
tasks.notes: sum of the two parameter values a+b

tasks.statement_en: One of the zeros of the quadratic function $f(x)=3x^2+7x+c$ is the number $-\frac{7}{3}$. Then $c$ equals: A. 0 B. 1 C. $-98$ D. 98

tasks.summary_en: Degree of the product of degree 2, 3, 2 polynomials
tasks.statement_en: Given are the polynomials $W(x)=2x^2-1$, $P(x)=x^3+x$, and $Q(x)=(1-x)(x+1)$. The degree of the polynomial $W(x)\cdot P(x)\cdot Q(x)$ equals: A. 3 B. 6 C. 7 D. 12
The first coordinate of the vertex of the parabola with equation $y=(x+2)(x-4)$ equals: A. $-8$ B. $-4$ C. 1 D. 2
In the geometric sequence $(a_n)$, defined for $n\ge1$, the term $a_1=5$, and the ratio $q=-2$. The sum of the first ten terms of this sequence equals: A. $-1705$ B. $-1023$ C. 1705 D. 5115
In the arithmetic sequence $(a_n)$, defined for $n\ge1$, two terms are given: $a_2=11$ and $a_4=7$. The sum of the first four terms of this sequence equals: A. 36 B. 40 C. 13 D. 20

tasks.statement_en: The measure of angle $\alpha$ satisfies $0°<\alpha<90°$. The expression $\frac{\cos^2\alpha}{1-\sin^2\alpha}+\frac{1-\cos^2\alpha}{\sin^2\alpha}$ equals: A. 1 B. $2\cos^2\alpha$ C. 2 D. $2\sin^2\alpha$

tasks.summary_en: Trapezoid KLMN: MN=3, KN=$4\sqrt3$, angle KLM=$60°$. Area?
tasks.statement_en: In trapezoid KLMN, in which $KL\parallel MN$, angle LKN is right (see figure), and given are: $|MN|=3$, $|KN|=4\sqrt3$, $\angle KLM=60°$. The area of this trapezoid equals: A. $4+2\sqrt3$ B. $10\sqrt3$ C. $20\sqrt3$ D. $24+6\sqrt3$ [Figure: right trapezoid KLMN with the right angle at K]

tasks.summary_pl: 40 stud. śr. 30, 20 stud. suma 1800. Śr. łącznie?
tasks.summary_en: 40 students avg 30, 20 students sum 1800. Combined avg?
tasks.statement_en: The arithmetic mean of the number of points obtained on the exam by students of group I, consisting of 40 students, is 30. Twenty students forming group II received a total of 1800 points. Therefore the average result of this exam, calculated jointly for all students from both groups, equals: A. 20 pts B. 30 pts C. 50 pts D. 60 pts

tasks.summary_en: Cube: angle IFK between face diagonals from F
tasks.statement_en: In cube EFGHIJKL, two diagonals of adjacent faces are drawn from vertex F: FI and FK (see figure). The measure of angle IFK equals: A. $30°$ B. $45°$ C. $60°$ D. $90°$ [Figure: cube with vertices E,F,G,H on the bottom face and I,J,K,L on the top face, diagonals FI and FK drawn on two adjacent side faces]

Point O is the center of the circle (see figure). The measure of angle LKM equals: A. $30°$ B. $60°$ C. $90°$ D. $120°$ [Figure: circle with center O and points K, L, M on the circle; at O, angle KOM (upper) is $130°$ and angle KOL (lower) is $110°$]

tasks.summary_pl: Okrąg opisany na trójkącie prost. 12,9. Promień?
tasks.summary_en: Circle circumscribed on right triangle 12,9. Radius?
tasks.statement_en: A circle is circumscribed on a right triangle whose legs have lengths 12 and 9. The radius of this circle equals: A. $\sqrt{108}$ B. $\frac{15}{2}$ C. 15 D. $\frac{\sqrt{108}}{2}$

From the set of consecutive natural numbers $\{1,2,3,4,\ldots,30\}$ we draw one number. The probability of the event that the drawn number is the square of an integer equals: A. $\frac{4}{30}$ B. $\frac{5}{30}$ C. $\frac{6}{30}$ D. $\frac{10}{30}$

tasks.summary_pl: Trójkąt EFG, EF=21, HI=7, GI=3 (równoległa). FI?
tasks.summary_en: Triangle EFG, EF=21, HI=7, GI=3 (parallel line). Find FI
tasks.statement_en: In triangle EFG, side EF has length 21. A line parallel to side EF intersects sides EG and FG of the triangle at points H and I respectively (see figure), such that $|HI|=7$ and $|GI|=3$. Then the length of segment FI equals: A. 6 B. 9 C. 12 D. 17 [Figure: triangle EFG with segment HI parallel to EF, H on EG, I on FG]

On a city map, drawn to a scale of 1:20000, a park is a rectangle with sides 2 cm and 5 cm. It follows that this park has an area of: A. $20\,000\text{ m}^2$ B. $40\,000\text{ m}^2$ C. $200\,000\text{ m}^2$ D. $400\,000\text{ m}^2$
The lines with equations $y=mx-5$ and $y=(1-2m)x+7$ are parallel when: A. $m=-1$ B. $m=-\frac13$ C. $m=\frac13$ D. $m=1$

tasks.topic_en: Lateral surface area of a cylinder
tasks.summary_en: Cylinder: r=4, V=$96\pi$. Lateral surface area?
tasks.statement_en: The volume of a cylinder with base radius 4 is $96\pi$. The lateral surface area of this cylinder equals: A. $16\pi$ B. $24\pi$ C. $32\pi$ D. $48\pi$

tasks.summary_en: Pyramid: V=432, base edge=12. Find height
tasks.statement_en: The volume of a regular quadrilateral pyramid is 432, and the base edge of this pyramid has length 12. The height of this pyramid equals: A. 3 B. 9 C. 27 D. 108
The angle $\alpha$ is acute and $\cos\alpha=\frac{\sqrt3}{3}$. Calculate the value of the expression $\frac{\sin\alpha}{\cos\alpha}+\frac{\cos\alpha}{1+\sin\alpha}$.
tasks.notes: Key excerpt for this open task was badly garbled (MathType); own solve gives a clean sqrt(3), consistent with the substitution step visible in the key text. [verified: ok: Expression simplifies to 1/cos(alpha)=3/sqrt3=sqrt3; matches key.]

tasks.statement_en: The numbers 6, $2x+4$, $x+26$, in the given order, are the first, second, and third terms of a certain arithmetic sequence. Calculate the common difference r of this sequence.

tasks.summary_en: Sets K, L of integers. P(product positive)?
tasks.statement_en: Given are two subsets of the set of integers: $K=\{-4,-1,1,5,6\}$ and $L=\{-3,-2,2,3,4\}$. One number is drawn from each of them. Calculate the probability of the event that the product of the drawn numbers is positive.

In the regular quadrilateral pyramid ABCDS (see figure), the diagonal AC of the base has length $4\sqrt2$. The angle ASC between opposite lateral edges of the pyramid measures $60°$. Calculate the volume of this pyramid. [Figure: square pyramid with base ABCD and apex S]

tasks.summary_pl: Wyścig 150km, Nowak o 1h50min krócej, o 11km/h szybciej. Prędkości? (suma)
tasks.statement_en: Mr. Nowak covered a 150 km stage of a cycling race in a time 1 hour and 50 minutes shorter than his teammate, Mr. Kowalski. The average speed at which Mr. Nowak rode this stage was 11 km/h greater than Mr. Kowalski's average speed on this route. Calculate the average speeds at which both riders covered the entire route.
tasks.notes: sum of the two riders' speeds (36 + 25)

tasks.summary_en: Isosceles triangle: A=(2,1), B=(5,2), leg on $2x-y-3=0$. Find C (sum)
tasks.statement_en: The base of isosceles triangle ABC is side AB, where $A=(2,1)$ and $B=(5,2)$. The leg of this triangle lies on the line with equation $2x-y-3=0$. Calculate the coordinates of vertex C.
